candidates.statement: Inventory deployment 3.3.3 has an invalid configuration revision (cfg-111, configuration_valid=false), producing 21 configuration rejections, 12 configuration_value_rejected ERROR logs with 503s, and a 0.15 error rate; gateway calls to inventory error at ~1011ms and inventory checkout spans error at ~1650ms, consistent with the checkout error-rate and latency alert.
candidates.uncertainty: Deployment record alone does not establish causation; gateway metrics/logs show healthy baseline, so impact is localized to inventory.

report.explanation: Inventory shows an invalid configuration revision with configuration rejections and 503 configuration_value_rejected errors, matching the checkout error-rate and latency alert via gateway-to-inventory error spans. Gateway itself is healthy (error_rate 0.001, p95 71ms, 200 logs), so the bounded candidate is bad-configuration in inventory.
